verdicts.reason: A is mostly a shrunken copy of the centred stack: the body copy is tiny, ends in an orphaned "sweet.", sits on the peach circle, and the CTA is jammed against the bottom edge with very little vertical breathing room. Still, the bottle, headline, CTA order and branding all survive. B reduces the hero bottle to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the top-right corner inside the green circle, so the product almost disappears. Its headline breaks awkwardly, leaving "fizz" alone on its own line, and the 3-line body text is tiny and sits on the peach circle in the cramped bottom-left.
